about: Summary of runs 5, 6 and 7 of the 30 prepared cases (2026-11-12, after the investigator prompt was changed a third time on these same 30 cases: the verdict order is store, then agent, then undetermined, then buyer; if the store did not charge or ship what the agent ordered, the store comes first), the two hold-out sets, and the abuse run, from the raw evidence files (not committed: they hold sandbox account and PayPal order identifiers). Identifiers removed; case ids S01-S30, H01-H10 and X01-X10 refer to scenarios/cases.json, scenarios/holdout.json and scenarios/holdout2.json. Sandbox only; the cases, agent logs and answer keys were written by us (hold-out 2 by a separate agent that had not read the prompt). The README table shows run 7. Runs 1-4 and the live-agent run are in 2026-11-12-summary.json and the README.

conditions.condition: 1. The same order is reported twice (two reports at the same moment)
conditions.observed: refunds on the PayPal order: 1; refund calls sent: 1; second report marked duplicate: true

conditions.condition: 2. The same refund request is sent again (same request id)
conditions.observed: PayPal answered with the first refund (same id); refunds on the PayPal order: 1

conditions.condition: 3. The amount is over the per-case limit ($50)
conditions.expected: checked first, no refund before the verdict
conditions.observed: $92.95: path VERIFY_FIRST (OVER_PER_CASE_CAP); refunds on the PayPal order right after the report: 0; after the verdict (AGENT): 1

conditions.condition: 4. More instant refunds than the 30-day count allows (2)
conditions.observed: paths: REFUND_FIRST -> REFUND_FIRST -> VERIFY_FIRST; third order refunds on PayPal at report: 0 (OVER_30_DAY_COUNT)

conditions.condition: 5. The buyer withdraws save-for-later consent before the charge
conditions.observed: verdict BUYER; re-charge HALTED (NO_ACTIVE_CONSENT); charge calls accepted by PayPal: 0; store PAID from desk:reserve

conditions.condition: 6. The buyer disputes during the notice period
conditions.observed: verdict BUYER; re-charge HALTED (BUYER_DISPUTED); charge calls accepted by PayPal: 0

conditions.expected: buyer keeps the refund, no re-charge
conditions.observed: verdict UNDETERMINED (R3); refund kept; charge calls accepted by PayPal: 0

conditions.condition: 8. A re-charge above the amount fixed at purchase is requested
conditions.expected: refused; only the fixed amount can be charged
conditions.observed: request for $35.99 refused (OVER_LIABILITY_CAP), calls sent: 0; then charged $34.99 = the refunded amount

conditions.condition: 9. The re-charge is requested twice (at the same moment, then once more)
conditions.observed: charge calls accepted by PayPal: 1; answers: charged, CHARGE_IN_PROGRESS, then ALREADY_CHARGED
